recommendations.DO_NOT_PAY: Do not pay any fee or deposit. Verify the employer and hiring process independently before taking action.
recommendations.CHECK_DOMAIN_BEFORE_ENTERING_DATA: Check the website domain carefully before entering any personal information.
recommendations.VERIFY_RECRUITER_OFFICIAL_CHANNEL: Verify the recruiter through the company's independently sourced official contact channels.
recommendations.ASK_WHY_DATA_NEEDED: Ask why sensitive information is needed and share only the minimum necessary at the appropriate stage.
recommendations.CONFIRM_OFFER_WITH_COMPANY: Confirm the offer details directly with the company through official, independently verified channels.
recommendations.CONTACT_1930_IF_PAID: If you have already sent money, contact the 1930 cybercrime helpline promptly and report through the official portal.
recommendations.NEVER_SHARE_CREDENTIALS: Never share passwords, OTPs, banking credentials, or remote-access codes with anyone.
recommendations.VERIFY_COMPANY_IDENTITY: Verify the company's identity using independent, official sources.

factors.UPFRONT_PAYMENT: The text asks the candidate to pay money or a fee as part of the process.
factors.GUARANTEED_SELECTION: The text promises guaranteed selection or placement without a normal process.
factors.ARTIFICIAL_URGENCY: The text creates pressure to act immediately.
factors.UNREALISTIC_COMPENSATION: The offered compensation may be unrealistic for the role or experience; verify independently.
factors.VAGUE_EMPLOYER_OR_ROLE: The employer identity or role responsibilities are unclear.
factors.SENSITIVE_DATA_REQUEST: The text requests sensitive personal or financial information.
factors.CONTRADICTION: Some details in the posting appear inconsistent; verify carefully.
factors.OFFPLATFORM_CONTACT: The text asks to move communication off official channels.
factors.OFFER_CONTACT_MISMATCH: Contact details in the offer do not align with independently verified company or recruiter information.
factors.COMPANY_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: The company name and website/domain do not appear consistent.
factors.RECRUITER_AFFILIATION_MISMATCH: Recruiter details do not clearly align with the claimed company.
factors.SUSPICIOUS_URL: The link or domain appears suspicious and should be verified before use.
factors.REPEATED_IDENTIFIER: Related identifiers appear across multiple records, which may warrant review.
factors.COMMUNITY_REPORTS_EXIST: Approved community reports exist; treat them as user-submitted information, not verified facts.

disclaimer.decision_support: This is a decision-support assessment, not a legal finding or verdict. Verify information independently.
